functionality.rationale: False acceptance would activate future-task TDD governance without proving chronology, criterion coverage, or evidence closure.

security.rationale: Acceptance must prove untrusted commands, forged proof, stale remote evidence, and mock topology cannot satisfy security-sensitive criteria.

performance.rationale: The full adversarial governance suite and detached proof replay must remain bounded enough for mandatory remote acceptance.

compatibility.rationale: Acceptance must prove both sides of the XT-083 boundary without rewriting or rejecting existing plans and task records.

concurrency.rationale: Adversarial acceptance covers claim locking, proof worktree cleanup, workflow job completion, and evidence publication races.

platform.rationale: The accepted workflow must preserve cross-platform path handling and validate required platform and role matrices.

persistence.rationale: Plan approval, proof digests, evidence bundles, and the activation threshold become durable audit provenance after acceptance.

adr.rationale: The task independently accepts implementation against ADR 0016 and introduces no additional decision.

architecture.rationale: Acceptance verifies integration-owned governance behavior without changing production architecture.

roadmap.rationale: The accepted capability affects future engineering process, not product roadmap scope.

acceptance.note: Accepted by the integration owner after repository verification.
